name: Hana no Koe
source:
I won a joke-like game contest.
The winning prize is "tree"
... but it was a boy who arrived at me.
A communal life with a mysterious boy who blooms was about to begin ...

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20921]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我赢得了一场类似笑话的游戏比赛。
获奖奖品是“树”
……但来到我身边的是一个男孩。
与绽放的神秘少年的共同生活即将开始……

[摘自 [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20921]Freem![/url]]
